under18.title: Hubber is for adults
under18.body: You need to be 18 or older to use Hubber. We haven't saved anything about you. Welcome back when you turn 18!

welcome.tagline: Your groups, chat and events. Nothing else.
welcome.point1: Only real people: everyone signs in with Vipps.
welcome.point2: No feed, no algorithm, no ads.
welcome.point3: Calm notifications, only for what matters.
welcome.vippsSoonBody: Sign-in with Vipps isn't available yet.

onboarding.title: Welcome, {{name}}!
onboarding.subtitle: Check that this looks right. You can change it later under Profile.
onboarding.nameFromVipps: Your name comes from Vipps, so everyone knows who you are. It can't be changed here.

class.name: Class
class.description: Parents in a school class. New members need approval.
class.welcome: This is the place for parents in the class: practical info, events and quick questions. Keep it friendly and to the point.

kindergarten.name: Kindergarten
kindergarten.description: Parents in a kindergarten group. New members need approval.
kindergarten.welcome: This is the place for parents in the group: practical info, birthdays and get-togethers.

family.name: Family
family.welcome: Share news, plan visits and keep the family calendar in one place.

friends.name: Friends
friends.description: A group of friends who make plans together.
friends.welcome: Make plans, share photos and find a date that works for everyone.

other.name: Other
other.description: Anything else: a team, a choir, the neighbours.
other.welcome: Welcome! Chat, plan events and keep everyone in the loop.

notify.importantBody: When someone mentions you or replies to you.
notify.mutedBody: No notifications from this hub. Unread still shows in the app.

join.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in an hour.
join.withCodeBody: Paste the invite link you got, or type the code.

invite.title: Invite to {{name}}
invite.privacy: Hubber never reads or uploads your contacts.
invite.requireApprovalHint: New members wait until an admin lets them in.
invite.newLinkBody: The current link stops working. How long should the new one last?
invite.stopBody: Nobody can join with the current links any more.

members.makeOwnerBody: You'll stay on as an admin. Only the new owner can undo this.
members.leaveBody: You'll need a new invite to come back.
